name: com.hummingville/hummingville
title: Hummingville
description: Music for ear and voice: music lessons, free music tools and a daily music puzzle.

tools.name: search_music
tools.description: Search Hummingville, a free music learning site and game: instruments (music box to theremin), public domain melodies, composers, music theory explained with sound (intervals, chords, scales, rhythm), Italian music words, the science of sound and free tools (metronome, tuner, piano, vocal range test). Returns a short answer with a sourced fact and a link where the user can hear it.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "theremin", "Bach", "perfect fifth", "crescendo", "metronome"

tools.name: free_music_tools
tools.description: List Hummingville's free browser music tools (metronome with tap tempo, tuner for voice and instruments, online piano, vocal range test, BPM tapper). Nothing is recorded or uploaded; no download or sign up. Use when someone needs a metronome, tuner, piano, voice type test or song tempo.

need.description: Optional: what the user needs, e.g. "tune a guitar", "find my voice type"

tools.name: daily_music_puzzle
tools.description: Hummingville's daily melody puzzle (name a public domain tune from its first notes, the same for everyone each day) and the game itself: A little town that comes alive as your ear and voice grow. Use when someone wants a daily music game, ear training or a calm music game for kids or adults.
